hours_spoken: Monday through Friday, 7 in the morning to 6 in the evening. Saturday, 8 to 1. Sunday, closed.

drain cleaning.blurb: Kitchen and bath drain cleaning is usually $149 to $289, depending on the clog.

water heater.blurb: A standard tank water heater install is usually $1,150 to $2,400. The plumber confirms the model on site.

leak repair.blurb: Leak calls start with a $189 dispatch. The repair itself is quoted after the plumber sees the pipe.

fixture install.blurb: A faucet or toilet install is usually $220 to $480 if the shutoff valves already work.

emergency_line: If water is actively flooding and it is safe to reach the valve, turn the fixture shutoff or the house main clockwise. If you smell gas, leave the house and call 911.
